checks.mode: passive_stateful; U=0/I=0; no delegation or tunnel updates

checks.limitation: Computation only; advertised bandwidth is not measured forwarding throughput or an established RSVP service.

checks.observed: Directed links16→15→14; P1→P2 removed first, P2→P1 after OSPF dead timer40s. No reverse edge synthesized.
6 nodes/16 directed links recovered; all original OSPF/LDP peers operational.
Published topology removed and unavailable status recorded; both PCEP peers remained established/fresh/synchronized; BGP-LS graph recovered.
All6 routers returned [OK] to write memory after final checks; pre-save startup backups retained. Three controller services enabled.

lab_scope: Six isolated CSR1000v routers and Ubuntu controller; console access only to GNS3 server; no server OS changes.
limitations: No PCEP PCReq computation reply, PCUpd or PCInitiate; no LSP delegation/control.
PCEP reports are not integrated with the reservation ledger.
BGP-LS physical interface state and complete IGP export cannot be proved; autonomous delivery remains disabled.
IOS XE16.9.7 is not qualified for autonomous CLI LSP writes.
No authenticated PCEPS/TLS session or packet throughput validation.

local_regression.scope: Offline regression tests include actual historical protocol captures; they do not replace the separately recorded live lab checks.
